non_blocking_findings.finding: GraphNode and GraphEdge are scoped by spaceId only. Context Hub session graph and Global graph currently render the same current-space snapshot with different UI modes.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add session-aware graph projection or documented aggregation rules before claiming per-session graph parity in Phase 6.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Native Canvas pan/zoom/tap selection is implemented, but automated HMA-AL00 evidence verifies routed Canvas presence, node chips, selection detail, relation display, and global mode rather than low-level multi-touch gesture physics.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated Compose UI or manual QA gesture matrix in NATIVE-UX-008 / NATIVE-P5-008 before replacement readiness.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Node edit/save, semantic fragment/card review, graph lifecycle review, and richer relationship/evidence sections are not implemented in this slice.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep LEG-020 and LEG-025 open and complete NATIVE-P5-004 before Phase 6 parity audit.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Graph state is visible in Context Hub and Global graph, but graph/source/memory context is not yet injected into chat turns.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Complete NATIVE-P5-007 and keep source/memory context replacement blockers open.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Large graphs are rendered and surfaced through a large-state summary, but clustering/filtering is deferred.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add clustering/filtering or a product-approved fallback before replacement readiness for large legacy graphs.
